title: Local git history diverged from GitHub (web-upload vs local-build), and repo is publicly visible
description:
Found 2026-08-29 while setting up beads federation. Local clone's git history (aa35778, from a Claude-artifact build) shared no common ancestor with derickca/Mini-convert on GitHub (built via GitHub's web-upload UI, commits like 'Add files via upload'). Also found the repo is PUBLIC on GitHub, which claude-config-repo.ps1 flags by default for repos carrying machine config.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. git fetch origin; git merge-base HEAD origin/main -> no output, exit 1 (no common ancestor).
2. gh repo view derickca/Mini-convert --json visibility -> PUBLIC.

## Resolution
Confirmed the two histories held byte-identical app content (index.html/app.js/styles.css/manifest.json/sw.js diffed clean). Reset local main to origin/main (the live, actually-deployed history) and cherry-picked the 4 beads/fleet-config commits on top -- clean fast-forward push, zero risk to the live GitHub Pages site. Public visibility is CORRECT and intentional here (Derick's wife uses the app via GitHub Pages) -- not a defect, left as-is.
close_reason: Reconciled 2026-08-29: local history rebased onto origin/main (byte-identical app content confirmed first), pushed as a clean fast-forward. Public visibility confirmed correct and intentional -- GitHub Pages serves the live app to Derick's wife.
